Title: MCP Interface and Tools
Content: MCP server: Orchestrator.Mcp on port 5100 (streamable HTTP /mcp) and stdio. Uses ModelContextProtocol NuGet package (not hand-rolled per D1). Tools include: code_review, refactor_code, generate_tests, run_tests, search_codebase, apply_patch. Each tool validates via FluentValidation. Idempotency via IIdempotencyCache with atomic TryReserve/TryRemove slot lifecycle (prevents duplicate execution on concurrent retries). Prompt injection sanitization on language/framework/coverage params in GenerateTestsTool (SanitizeParam + SanitizeForFence). RunTestsTool enforces allowedRoot path scope on every call.
